titleText: JTF News: CBC News, BBC News
mainText: Oil prices reached $100 per barrel for the first time since May.
Approximately 12,000 people evacuated in France due to fires.
President Trump stated that Saudi Arabia must recognize Israel for a nuclear deal.
The European Union agreed on a new round of sanctions against Russia.

titleText: JTF News: Deutsche Welle, European Commission
mainText: The European Union imposed an €890 million fine on Google related to its Play app store and search practices.
